en.headline: Link REIT to sell Mong Kok T.O.P for HK$2.3 billion
en.dek: The trust will dispose of its entire interest in 700 Nathan Road to Han Bliss Global, with completion expected in early 2027, and continue managing the property.
body: Link Real Estate Investment Trust announced on Friday that it has agreed to sell its entire interest in the property at 700 Nathan Road, known as T.O.P This is Our Place, in Mong Kok for HK$2.3 billion to Han Bliss Global Limited.

The trust said the property is considered non-core because most of its income comes from the office portion. Link acquired the building in 2016, renovated it and repositioned the retail floors as a destination for younger shoppers with new brands and pop-ups.

Completion is expected in the first quarter of 2027. Link will enter an asset management agreement to continue managing the property after the sale. Net proceeds are intended for unit buy-backs, working capital or reinvestment in its core portfolio of shopping malls and car parks.

John Saunders, Link’s executive director and chief investment officer, said the disposal allows the trust to release capital while applying its asset management expertise for the new owner, supporting its third-party capital business.

zh.headline: 領展以23億元出售旺角T.O.P物業
zh.dek: 基金同意出售彌敦道700號全部權益予Han Bliss Global，交易預料2027年首季完成，其後繼續管理該物業。
body: 領展房地產投資信託基金周五宣布，同意以23億元出售旺角彌敦道700號「T.O.P This is Our Place」全部權益予Han Bliss Global Limited。
基金表示，該物業主要收入來自寫字樓部分，屬非核心資產。領展於2016年購入該大廈，其後翻新，並將零售樓層重新定位為面向年輕消費者的潮流購物目的地，引入新品牌及快閃店。
交易預料2027年第一季完成。領展將簽訂資產管理協議，於出售後繼續管理該物業。出售所得淨額擬用於回購基金單位、營運資金或再投資核心商場及停車場組合。
執行董事兼首席投資總裁宋俊彥表示，出售可釋放資金，同時繼續運用資產管理專業為新業主管理物業，有助拓展第三方資本業務。
